concerns.text: FR-006 mandates a sensitivity sweep over the specific set {0.45, 0.55, 0.75, 0.85}. Task T030-RunSweep description contains a syntax error and incomplete parameter list (`{, 0.75, 0.85}`), missing 0.45 and 0.55. This prevents the task from satisfying the functional requirement.

SC-003 defines the success metric as 'variance of p-values ≤ 0.001 OR rank order preserved'. Task T032-VerifySC003 only instructs calculating the variance, omitting the verification of the 'rank order preservation' condition. The task cannot fully satisfy the success criterion.

FR-007 requires repeating the analysis on 'warm-dark-matter (WDM) variant snapshots'. While T031-LogGap handles Millennium-II gaps, it only explicitly mentions marking SC-004 as 'Not Measurable' for Millennium-II. It lacks explicit instructions to handle the WDM variant gap (e.g., logging WDM status separately or ensuring SC-004 logic accounts for WDM absence specifically), creating a coverage gap for the WDM portion of FR-007.

Task T018 is marked as 'CRITICAL ADDITION' and 'BLOCKING' for central galaxy property ingestion but is listed as unchecked (`[ ]`). Given the dependency chain (T023a, T023b, T036, T038 all depend on T018), this unchecked status implies the requirement (FR-001/US-1) for central galaxy properties is not currently satisfied by the task state, creating a logical inconsistency in the plan's readiness.
